lyrics.original: 1回の喧嘩, 2週ひっぱるから
lyrics.romanization: ikkai no kenka, ni shuu hipparukara
lyrics.english: One fight, Lasts two weeks

lyrics.original: もう三回は耐えたのに
lyrics.romanization: mou san kai wa taetanoni
lyrics.english: So I've held back three times

lyrics.original: また失敗重ね, 誤解ばかり
lyrics.romanization: mata shippai kasane, gokai bakari
lyrics.english: But I keep slipping up, Just misunderstandings

lyrics.original: 僕の愛情はなんなんだ
lyrics.romanization: boku no aijou wa nann nann da
lyrics.english: What is my love worth?

lyrics.original: ねえ、どうして？, 思い違いで
lyrics.romanization: nee doushite?, omoichigai de
lyrics.english: Come on, what's wrong with you?, We get the wrong idea

lyrics.original: 美味しいはずの beer もまずいよ
lyrics.romanization: oishii hazu no beer mo mazui yo
lyrics.english: And great beer starts to taste flat

lyrics.original: マジなんで, Timing 失ったプレゼントもう渡せないよ
lyrics.romanization: maji nande, timing ushinatta purezento mou watasenai yo
lyrics.english: Really, what's with you?, Timing's off for giving you your gift now

lyrics.original: 一瞬の小さな火花のはずが
lyrics.romanization: isshun no chiisana hibana no hazu ga
lyrics.english: It could've stopped at a small spark

lyrics.original: うっかりため息ついたら, もっと燃える君と, 灰になってく僕
lyrics.romanization: ukkari tameiki tsui tara, motto moeru kimi to, haininatte ku boku
lyrics.english: But I let a sigh slip out, You flare up more and more, While I turn to ash

lyrics.original: 突然 終わりなんてごめんだから
lyrics.romanization: totsuzen owari nante gomen dakara
lyrics.english: I'd hate for it to end abruptly

lyrics.original: 今日もちゃんと我慢してんの
lyrics.romanization: kyou mo chanto gaman shite n no
lyrics.english: So I'm holding back again today

lyrics.original: 何で苦しめる？, 僕も人間(ひと)なのに
lyrics.romanization: nani de kurushimeru?, boku mo hito nano ni
lyrics.english: Why are you doing this to me?, I'm human too, you know

lyrics.original: 無理！1回の喧嘩, 2週ひっぱるから
lyrics.romanization: muri ikkai no kenka, ni shuu hipparu kara

lyrics.english: And you, You're always glaring at me

lyrics.original: ねえ、三度目の正直あるの？
lyrics.romanization: nee sandome no shoujiki aru no?
lyrics.english: Come on, is third time the charm for chances?

lyrics.original: ほんと余計みじめ, 5歳児のように
lyrics.romanization: honto yokei mijime, go saiji no you ni
lyrics.english: It only makes me feel worse, I'm counting like a five-year-old
